description:
How many X posts mentioned a crypto asset's cashtag, per hour or per day, over the last 1 to 31 days. This is the XPostCount series the x_attention signals (x_post_count_spike, x_attention_elevated, x_attention_price_divergence) read. Counts exclude reposts and promoted posts; x_query=en_original also drops replies and keeps English only. The series ends at the last settled bucket (closed at least five minutes ago). Use it to show a token's attention trend, to explain why an X signal fired, or to pick a z_threshold. Counts are post volume, not sentiment. Repeat reads are served from cache.

[Access: pay 0.02 USDC via x402 (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header) OR authenticate with an API key. An x402-capable client will auto-pay; API-key clients pay nothing per call.]

days_back.description: Window in days ending now, 1 to 31.

symbol.description: Asset symbol, e.g. BTC or ETH.

x_query.description: all (default) or en_original (no replies, English only).

name: get_x_post_counts
